note: What ran on the LP-MSPM0L1306 (probe ML130001) in Chrome through bench-test.mjs --controls. A row kind is listed only for what that run proved; anything not listed shows 'Predicted, not tested here'. BoosterPack rows are always predicted: no BoosterPack was on this board.

pin-read.label: Tested here
pin-read.note: PA22 read: the program applied it and reported the level (low). The level was not compared with a known input.

pin-high.label: Tested here
pin-high.note: PA26 driven high: the pad read high in 588 of 588 samples through the debugger.

pin-low.label: Tested here
pin-low.note: PA26 driven low: the pad read high in 0 of 576 samples through the debugger.

toggle.label: Tested here
toggle.note: PA26 at 200 and 300 ms timed 200 to 203 and 294 to 299 ms; PA13 at 100 and 400 ms timed 99 to 100 and 396 to 399 ms, from the pin's output register.

pwm.label: Tested here: the timer
pwm.note: Six settings (PA26 and PA13, 100 Hz to 20 kHz, 10 to 75 percent): load and compare registers equal the values the page worked out, the counter moves, and its share above the compare value was within 1 point of the duty. A steady 100 percent was read from the pad. The waveform on the pad was not observed: the GPIO input register does not follow a timer-driven pad (TI's own PWM example reads the same), and the LED was not watched.

scan.label: Tested here: found nothing
scan.note: The scan ran from 0x08 to 0x77 and nothing acknowledged, as expected with no part on PA0 and PA1. It has not yet found a part on this board.
